title: Export website exploration evidence
description: ONLY when the user explicitly requests website exploration or an exploration report. Capture selected controls at a current page revision and export a verified Markdown evidence file. Independent from atomic execution: never invoked automatically.
guidance: No navigation, LLM loop, dataset collection or page modification. Returns caller-owned evidence ID retained for 24 hours or until browser exit, and a durable file path. Use a fresh idempotency key for a new capture; reuse the same key/input to recover a receipt.

inputSchema.description: Capture explicitly requested website exploration evidence from selected current controls. No browsing or actions are performed.

expectedRevision.description: Current observation revision; stale captures fail closed.

label.description: Meaningful page or explored state name.

targetIds.description: Select only relevant observed controls, never records for bulk data collection. Empty captures document the page identity only.

outputSchema.description: Confirmed exploration evidence and durable Markdown artifact.

evidenceId.description: Opaque evidence ID for report export; not an action handle.

path.description: Confirmed Markdown file in the configured export directory, or the browser download directory.
